args.summary: One device (FX-RAM-01, hostname fx-latitude-ram) shows persistent high memory usage across the telemetry window, with RAM at or above 95% in 10 of 14 daily snapshots. A second device (FX-RAM-02, hostname fx-macbook-spike) had a brief spike (2 consecutive days at ≥95%) but is not yet classified as persistent.

claims.text: Device FX-RAM-01 (fx-latitude-ram) has persistent RAM constraint: RAM ≥95% in 10 of 14 snapshots (71% of days), max 3 consecutive days, on a 16 GB device.
Device FX-RAM-02 (fx-macbook-spike) had a short spike: RAM ≥95% on 2 consecutive snapshots (14% of days), on a 32 GB device; classified as flagged, not persistent.
One device had too few snapshots for trend assessment; its latest snapshot was still checked.

caveats: One RAM reading per day: high usage at that moment, not proof of sustained memory pressure.
Too few snapshots for a trend on 1 device(s) (a trend needs 7). Their latest snapshot was still checked, so this says nothing about their current state.
